verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a personal agent, but the evidence never states it outright. Muse only implies multi-item work: it has its own terminal and file system and can write code and tools for a task, and it can audit subscriptions and cancel unneeded ones. Each of those cancellations or spends still requires approval before it happens. missing for 10: explicit bulk or batch action capability (e.g., mass email triage or bulk edits), documentation of how many items can be handled at once, a batch-approval flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
